title: Unlocking Nellore's Ethanol Opportunity
subtitle: Feedstock, Infrastructure & the Road to E20
audience: Capacity building programme | Government of Andhra Pradesh
source_note: What the National Ethanol Blending Programme means for Sri Potti Sriramulu Nellore District

sections.title: The Case for Ethanol — Why Now

items.title: Import dependence
items.body: India imports over 85% of its crude oil; every litre of blended ethanol displaces imported fuel and saves foreign exchange.

items.title: Untapped feedstock surplus
items.body: Nellore's paddy, maize and sugarcane belts generate surplus and damaged grain that fetch limited value beyond the food-grain market.

items.title: Volatile farm incomes
items.body: Single-crop dependence and price swings leave paddy and cane growers exposed to weak, unpredictable seasonal returns.

items.title: Rising national demand
items.body: The push toward 20% blending (E20) is opening assured, long-term offtake for new distillery capacity across India.

sections.title: The Answer: National Ethanol Blending Programme

blocks.text: Under the EBP, Oil Marketing Companies purchase ethanol from molasses- and grain-based distilleries at pre-fixed prices for blending into petrol. It lets districts like Nellore convert surplus grain and cane into a guaranteed second market.

items.label: national blending target set for ESY 2025-26 (E20)

blocks.title: What the EBP delivers
items: A new demand stream for surplus paddy, maize & molasses
Valuable by-products — DDGS cattle feed, bio-CNG
Reduced crude import bill & vehicular emissions

sections.title: How an Ethanol Value Chain Would Work

stages.name: Feedstock
stages.desc: Paddy, maize & cane surplus aggregated from farmers and mandi networks

stages.name: Distillery
stages.desc: Grain- and molasses-based distillation into fuel-grade ethanol

stages.name: Blending
stages.desc: Ethanol supplied to OMC depots for blending into petrol (E20)

stages.name: Distribution
stages.desc: Blended fuel moves via road & Krishnapatnam Port to retail pumps

stages.name: End Use
stages.desc: Cleaner-burning fuel for vehicles across Andhra Pradesh and beyond

blocks.closing: A district-anchored distillery keeps processing margins local — while by-products like DDGS and bio-CNG open a second revenue line.

sections.title: Five Pillars for Building Nellore's Ethanol Capacity

items.title: Feedstock aggregation & FPCs
items.body: Organise paddy, maize and cane growers so distilleries get consistent, quality-graded volumes.

items.title: Distillery capacity
items.body: Attract new dual-feed (grain + molasses) distilleries, or expand existing sugar-mill capacity.

items.title: Assured OMC offtake
items.body: Long-term supply agreements with Oil Marketing Companies de-risk investment and lock in prices.

items.title: Port & logistics
items.body: Krishnapatnam Port and NH16 connectivity support feedstock movement and by-product export.

items.title: By-product utilisation
items.body: DDGS as cattle feed and bio-CNG from spent wash add income and cut waste.

sections.title: Who Benefits — Farmers and the State

cols.title: For Farmers
items: Assured market for surplus & damaged grain
Additional income stream beyond food-grain sales
Demand for maize as a rotation crop
New rural jobs in distilleries & logistics

cols.title: For the State & Nation
items: Progress toward the national E20 blending target
A replicable model for other AP grain belts

items.title: Assess feedstock surplus
items.body: Map paddy, maize and molasses surplus by mandal; identify volumes viable for a distillery-ready supply chain.

items.title: Attract distillery investment
items.body: Court dual-feed (grain + molasses) distillery investment, or support expansion of existing sugar mills.

items.title: Secure OMC offtake agreements
items.body: Tie up long-term ethanol supply contracts with Oil Marketing Companies before capacity is built.

items.title: Build farmer aggregation
items.body: Strengthen FPCs/FPOs so growers can supply consistent, graded feedstock volumes.

items.title: Scale via by-products & logistics
items.body: Add DDGS and bio-CNG lines; route exports and inputs through Krishnapatnam Port.

items.title: Feedstock price volatility
items.body: Grain and cane prices can swing with the food market, affecting distillery economics.

items.title: Water stress
items.body: Cane cultivation is water-intensive; distilleries also need managed effluent and water use.

items.title: Capital intensity
items.body: New distillery and storage infrastructure requires significant upfront investment.

items.title: Food-versus-fuel concerns
items.body: Diverting grain to ethanol must be balanced against local food and fodder needs.

items.title: Logistics bottlenecks
items.body: Moving feedstock and by-products smoothly needs coordinated road, rail and port capacity.

items.title: Ethanol is a new demand stream
items.body: It turns surplus and damaged grain into an assured, price-linked market.

items.title: Offtake de-risks investment
items.body: OMC agreements guarantee buyers before a rupee of distillery capital is spent.

items.title: By-products add a second revenue layer
items.body: DDGS and bio-CNG turn waste streams into additional income.

items.title: Infrastructure is a natural advantage
items.body: Krishnapatnam Port and NH16 give Nellore logistics few districts can match.

items.title: Start with pilots, scale with policy
items.body: Anchor around one distillery and one crop belt, then expand as volumes and offtake grow.

sections.title: From Opportunity to Action
sections.lead: Your task before you leave today:

Map surplus paddy, maize and molasses feedstock by mandal.

blocks.text: Every litre of local ethanol is a litre of imported fuel we no longer need.
